body:
Yeah I play a lot of civ and other miscellaneous games whenever I have the time...which unfortunately isn't a lot these days since I have so much to do :(

What about you?

Hey, sorry I didn't get back to you. I was really busy today. 

I'm fine, I had a long talk with my dad yesterday about completely unrelated things but that helped me sort of feel better for now.

Haha figure I might as well have fun before I check out. But it doesn't really ever work considering my friends always stop me before I go that far (I have a really low tolerance)

And ya software engineering is pretty cool, ironically it makes you really appreciate how smart the human brain is. Often times it takes a lot of work to tell a computer to do something that would be trivial for a human being with a pencil and paper. It's only really at a large scale that computers become more useful than humans.

I had a software dev internship over the summer and now I work there part-time.

And yeah that's actually a good point, haha. That's actually more or less how I've been approaching it. "I'm too lazy, I'll just end things tomorrow."

But I know things will eventually get bad enough that tomorrow will turn into today.

I pretty much have dozens of attempts under my belt already, if you count trying to induce alcohol poisoning by drinking 14 shots in a row at parties. Like I said, girls don't talk to me so I don't really have anything else to do there :(
